capabilities: render album folders as grid galleries in notes
insert album blocks or collapsible callouts via commands
open photos in the image viewer on click
extras: The manifest carries an 'not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff' notice; cached thumbnails live in .obsidian/plugins/photo-album/thumbnails and can be deleted safely.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to display a folder of photos as a gallery grid within a note.
summary: Photo album plugin that renders folders of images as grid galleries in notes with cached thumbnails.
